name: Shinjite Okuridashita Hitozuma no Ami ga Dousoukai de Motokare ni, NTR Namahame Choukyou Sareru Wake ga Nai!
original_name: 信じて送り出した人妻のアミが同窓会で元彼に、NTR生ハメ調教される訳がない!
source:
Ami's ex takes her back at their high school reunion, 
even though she's now a happily married woman. 

It's a one night stand full of firsts, even with an old lover: 
her first affair, her first anal, cosplaying and f*cking 
with a camera to document the dirty deed. 

She even has a phone conversation with her husband 
while her ex-boyfriend is deep inside her.
